# MÖBIUS

> A local-first Windows workspace for Codex, Claude Code, Pi, Grok, and OMP. It groups sessions by project, resumes the original harness, and hands off references rather than summaries.

Möbius is open-source desktop software by Tardis. It is not Microsoft Mobius, ControlTheory Möbius, or Circular Labs Mobius. Current preview: v0.3.19 for Windows, MIT licensed, $0. It does not sell model accounts.

## What Möbius is

Möbius indexes approved local agent transcripts by project directory and worktree. Native resume stays with the original harness. Switching agents starts a new target session and carries confirmed Session references, not a generated summary.

## What Möbius is not

- It does not provide model accounts, subscriptions, or API credits.
- It does not rewrite Codex, Claude Code, Pi, Grok, or OMP transcripts.
- It does not inject other sessions into context by default.
- Semantic / vector search is not available in v0.3.19. Local recall is FTS/BM25 only.

## Core workflows

1. Find sessions from the project and worktree, then inspect the exact source message.
2. Resume the original agent in an interactive PowerShell tab, or open a blank terminal.
3. Hand off a reviewable reference envelope to another agent in the same checkout.
4. Follow the project handoff graph back to confirmed ancestors.
5. Keep Markdown notes, a multimedia canvas, read-only folder mounts, and managed skills beside the workbench.

## Precise search vs full-text vs semantic

- Precise references: copy `@session:provider/id#mN` when the source is known.
- Full-text recall: Mome uses local SQLite FTS/BM25, returns at most three citable sessions, and caps output at about 1,200 tokens.
- Semantic / vector / hybrid search: not available in this release.

## Supported harnesses

Codex, Claude Code, Pi, Grok, and OMP. Native resume is shown only when the installed harness has a verified resume protocol. Current Grok history remains inspect/search/handoff-only.

## Key facts

- Author: Tardis
- License: MIT
- Price: $0
- Platform: Windows preview
- Version: 0.3.19
- Search: local SQLite FTS/BM25; no embeddings
- Handoff: reference-only; source transcripts stay read-only
- Distinct from: Microsoft Mobius, ControlTheory Möbius, Circular Labs Mobius
